subject.title: Fix bundled ChatGPT Codex CLI discovery

question: Should CodexBar accept the verified pinned OpenAI bundle identity as the automatic launch trust contract for the ChatGPT-bundled Codex CLI?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but deciding how narrowly to recognize an executable embedded in another application is a repository-owner security policy choice.

options.title: Accept pinned identity
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks because the fail-closed contract matches the verified current ChatGPT app and minimizes executable-substitution risk.

options.title: Define broader identity policy
options.body: Pause to identify and test additional acceptable OpenAI bundle identities, trading a wider trust surface for future compatibility.

recommendation.title: Accept pinned identity
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks because the fail-closed contract matches the verified current ChatGPT app and minimizes executable-substitution risk.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the resolver and launch-preflight history and authored the exact verified trust-boundary implementation.
